models: Audi A4 / VW Passat / Skoda Octavia
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Left Parking Brake Motor (V282) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantıları(s)
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Left Parking Brake Motor (V282)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Left Parking Brake Motor (V282)
technicalNotes:
When found in VW Passat (3C): Parking Brake, clear Fault Codes with Engine running (to ensure proper Voltage Supply).
Switch Ignition OFF for about 10 Seconds
Start the Engine and keep it running while trying to clear Fault Codes.
Press the Parking Brake Button (E538) in 5 Second Intervals.
